info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Customer Management Account Recoverys-spec
info.description: The Customer Account Recovery API allows financial institutions to manage account recovery requests for their customers efficiently. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of ongoing and completed recovery operations, helping support teams monitor and respond to customer needs effectively. It is ideal for customer service representatives and IT support teams who handle account-related issues. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer support capabilities and improve overall user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve account recovery information for a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the necessary information for customers to recover their accounts. It provides essential data and guidelines to assist users in regaining access to their accounts securely.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for the account recovery process. It allows the client to send necessary data to initiate the recovery operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully with account recovery details.
